purpose: Independent held-out qualification cases grounded before model evaluation or tuning.

cases.query: Running one selected node should schedule its enabled upstream dependencies, excluding unrelated sibling nodes and sources connected only by disabled wires.

evidence.reason: Only enabled edges populate the incoming and outgoing dependency tables.
Explicit targets seed dependency traversal instead of scheduling every node.
Asserts the enabled producer and sink are scheduled while the disabled producer and sibling are absent.

cases.query: Loading old recovery metadata should refuse a document containing unresolved add-ons but quietly discard empty recovery envelopes.

evidence.reason: Inspects recovery payload content, raises for unresolved content, and removes empty legacy metadata.
Invokes the recovery-metadata gate during project decoding.
A recovery envelope containing a missing plugin node must raise an unresolved-add-ons error.
Asserts both empty recovery metadata keys disappear from the decoded project.

cases.query: Parent assignment must reject self-parenting, a missing parent, and making an ancestor a child of its descendant without changing the existing hierarchy.

evidence.reason: Rejects unknown nodes, self-parenting, unknown parents, and cyclic parent links.
Walks parent ancestry with a visited set to detect cycles.
Exercises all three rejected assignments and verifies the original root, child, and grandchild relationships remain intact.

cases.query: Exporting the same node package with source files listed in different orders must produce identical archive bytes, with sorted members and fixed timestamps.

evidence.reason: Creates archive entries with the fixed archive timestamp and stored compression.
Writes canonical manifest bytes and iterates package members in sorted order.
Reverses input source order, compares the resulting archive bytes, and asserts member order and the fixed 1980 timestamp.

cases.query: Nested property defaults must be detached from the caller's mutable data, and each materialized default must receive fresh containers while preserving list and tuple distinctions.

evidence.reason: Recursively captures supported records and container contents into immutable templates instead of retaining caller aliases.
Reconstructs fresh dictionaries, lists, tuples, sets, and supported records according to the captured kind.
Mutates both the original nested default and one materialized value, then asserts later values remain unchanged with their tuple/list structure preserved.

cases.query: Releasing a run's handle lease must leave an existing viewer lease usable, and the resource must be disposed only when its final lease is removed.

evidence.reason: Returns without disposal while leases remain; detaches and disposes the record only after the last lease is removed.
Removes one owner's leases while retaining records owned by other scopes.
Releases the run scope, rejects its stale reference, and still resolves the viewer reference to the original object.
Protects the single-disposal contract when final leases are released concurrently.

cases.query: The canvas zoom entry should accept decimal percentages such as 83.5%, clamp out-of-range values, and reject text such as 75junk without changing zoom.

evidence.reason: Validates the complete entry with an optional percent suffix before emitting a zoom request.
Rejects non-finite input and clamps accepted values to the configured zoom range.
Checks clamping, junk rejection, blank input, decimal percentages, and displayed precision.

cases.query: Refreshing an inline list must retain controls for existing rows and keep numeric column selectors distinct from identically spelled string selectors.

evidence.reason: Updates existing model rows in place, appends only new rows, and removes only surplus rows.
Returns each row's original variant value without converting all selectors to strings.
Compares delegate identity through edits, additions and removals, then distinguishes numeric 1 from string 1.

cases.query: Dragging a plot inspection cursor should keep only one query in flight, coalesce rapid movement to the latest position, and never paint an obsolete reply.

evidence.reason: Tracks one in-flight revision, retains the latest pending request, and applies a 100 ms movement interval.
Accepts only the current in-flight reply and publishes it only if its revision is still the latest.
Sends 100 rapid positions, asserts only one initial request, rejects the stale result, and sends the latest position after the throttle interval.

cases.query: Inline viewer activation changes must defer synchronization with the host when the host immediately emits session changes, avoiding a QML binding loop.

evidence.reason: Coalesces synchronization with a queued flag and Qt.callLater so it does not re-enter a session-model binding.
Mirrors the real synchronous host-to-session signal chain and verifies live activation/deactivation without binding-loop messages.

cases.query: Loading graph label font sizes below 8 or above 50 should clamp them, non-integer entries should use the default, and unrelated grid preferences should survive.

evidence.reason: Rejects booleans and non-integers to the default and clamps integer values to the supported range.
Loads missing, string, too-small and too-large sizes; asserts expected values and preservation of the disabled grid setting.

cases.query: A descending interval must stay descending when its slider commits, even though its handles are displayed in ascending left-to-right order.

evidence.reason: Maps the visually ordered handle values back to semantic start/end according to the declared interval direction.
Sets decreasing direction with physical values 3 and 7, commits, and asserts semantic start 7 and end 3.

cases.query: Applying edited Python Script declarations must report syntax locations for bad source and leave the current node unchanged; valid declarations must reconcile properties, ports and connected wires together.

evidence.reason: Parses applied source without executing it and converts syntax errors into line-and-column declaration errors.
Builds and validates candidate settings and ports before reconciling node state and incident wires.
Covers source-located validation failure without partial Apply mutation.
Checks property reset after narrowing, unchanged node/edges after invalid syntax, and removal of incompatible wire and port state after a structural change.

cases.query: Switching Number Slider settings to integer rounding must disable decimal-place entry and snap the committed minimum, maximum and value to whole numbers.

evidence.reason: Enables decimal-place entry only in decimal rounding mode.
Normalizes rounding and precision, snaps integer-mode bounds, repairs the range if necessary, and normalizes the value.
Creates the actual popover, switches to integer mode, and asserts that the decimals field is disabled.
Asserts fractional bounds and value become the expected integer-valued properties through registry normalization.

cases.query: Trace how an abbreviated millisecond display preference is normalized and how the canvas footer renders the same stored millisecond duration as either seconds or milliseconds.

evidence.reason: Normalizes whitespace/case and aliases such as ms to the canonical milliseconds preference.
Formats the same millisecond input with an ms suffix or converts it to seconds and minutes according to the preference.
Loads the spaced uppercase MS alias and asserts the canonical milliseconds result.
Invokes the real canvas-host timing scenario that renders 3.5s and then 3487ms after changing the display unit.

cases.query: Trace fullscreen viewer tangent-angle editing from its bounded spin box through the application-wide preference update, including clamping angles above 90 degrees.

evidence.reason: Forwards normalized UI values to the tangent-angle bridge setter; the spin box uses limits 0 and 90.
Normalizes the requested angle, updates engineering-viewer graphics preferences, and emits the normalized value.
Owns finite-value fallback and clamping to the inclusive 0-to-90-degree range.
Creates the fullscreen controls, asserts tangent spin-box bounds, invokes angle editing, and verifies the bridge callback receives 42 degrees.
Sets 120 degrees and asserts an application preference update and change signal containing 90 degrees.

cases.query: decimate_xy

evidence.reason: The sole Python definition of this symbol in active ea_node_editor and corex source; implements bounded min-max series reduction.
Calls the function directly and verifies budget, extrema, row order, and endpoint preservation.

cases.query: ea_node_editor/ui_qml/components/graph/surface_controls/GraphSurfaceColorEditor.qml

evidence.reason: The exact existing component resolves a chosen color, updates its field, and emits the committed color.
Clicks the actual inline picker and verifies node identity, property key, current color, selected text, and emitted commit.

cases.query: Find COREX's existing chess move generator that rejects moves leaving the king in check and handles castling.
Find COREX's existing MIDI sequencer that schedules Note On and Note Off messages and applies pitch-bend events.

caveats: Read-only grounding only: no files edited, no tests executed, and no model or external API calls made.
Labels were selected from inspected source and test assertions before seeing pilot output.
Negative cases have no source-line evidence; their explicit bounded absence checks returned zero matching active source/test files.
Some test paths contain shared suites or QML tests rather than standalone pytest entry points.
Expected groups are owner coverage requirements; each inner list currently contains one acceptable exact path.
